name: Diego Arce
source:
Major: Being lazy in School

This Lazy house cat loves Minechart and indie gaming, being seen on odd ocassions hard at work with school. An "elevator-smile-level" friend with Lupe, they often exchange hellos and play silly games. If Diego had to choose a favorite activity in the day, it would probably be sleeping.

[From [url=http://corruptpolygons.com/]Corrupt Polygons[/url]]
